abstract: Maintains auxiliary fuel depot availability and ground refuel readiness records
system_message:
You are the Forward logistics coordinator (LOG), responsible for maintaining auxiliary fuel depot availability, ground refuel readiness records, and auxiliary depot power generation monitoring.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains auxiliary fuel depot availability and ground refuel readiness records（FUEL）
information_points.content:
LOG-FUEL-JUD：According to the tactical fuel depot readiness log for Kicking Horse Pass Approach, depot refueling readiness is confirmed true at the designated waypoint fuel caching helipad, with fueling pump equipment and aviation fuel reserves fully cleared for operation.
LOG-FUEL-TDB：The tactical fuel depot readiness log records that Monashee Crest Bypass maintains depot refueling readiness as true, with aviation fuel reserves and fueling pump equipment cleared for operation at the designated waypoint fuel caching helipad.
LOG-FUEL-8WT：For Cariboo Trench Low-Level Route, the tactical fuel depot readiness log indicates that depot refueling readiness is false, as fueling pump equipment and aviation fuel reserves at the designated waypoint fuel caching helipad are not cleared for operation.

information_points.title: Auxiliary depot power generation（PWR）
information_points.content:
LOG-PWR-97P：For Cariboo Trench Low-Level Route, remote depot maintenance records show a ground generator fuel reserve of 40 h of autonomous continuous power generation in the standby generator diesel tank.
LOG-PWR-4HN：Remote depot maintenance logs for Kicking Horse Pass Approach indicate that the standby generator diesel tank provides a ground generator fuel reserve of 120 h of autonomous continuous power generation.
LOG-PWR-I8D：Regarding Monashee Crest Bypass, remote depot maintenance logs show a ground generator fuel reserve of 75 h of autonomous continuous power generation at the forward fueling site.
